newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T keeps open mind as merger talk lifts shares.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T keeps open mind as merger talk lifts shares.

text.p: B.A.T Industries said on Monday it was keeping an open mind about opportunities to restructure its operations after weekend press reports that the group is continuing its search for a partner for its financial services businesses.

B.A.T, however, refused to comment directly on reports that talks with another company - said to be insurance group Commercial Union - had foundered. Commercial Union was similarly tight-lipped, declining to confirm or deny the rumours.
Bolstered by the deal talk, B.A.T shares pushed 17p higher to 468-1/2p but a spokesman for the company said its position had not changed.
"We were widely reported as having ruled out a demerger at the third quarter (results) and now we're reported to be ruling it in. The true position is that we have an open mind," the spokesman said.
